title: Joint behavioral decoding and neural prediction from full spatial imaging fields
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Joint prediction of neural images and behavior from neural image history: WFCI1 continuous behavior, WFCI2 binary contact traces, and fUS trial target direction. Neural/continuous predictions are one-step-ahead; fUS direction is decoded from the final trial latent state.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Joint prediction of neural images and behavior from neural image history: WFCI1 continuous behavior, WFCI2 binary contact traces, and fUS trial target direction. Neural/continuous predictions are one-step-ahead; fUS direction is decoded from the final trial latent state.

Source-paper comparison for WFCI1 behavioral MSE is a numeric anchor only; full Table 2–3 joint vector required: MSE is mean squared prediction error (lower); WFCI2 behavior uses F1 (higher); fUS accuracy is correctly decoded trials divided by evaluated trials (higher). Full source vector must be retained; one chosen favorable endpoint cannot establish the joint claim.
success_criteria: Reproduce all Table 2–3 SBIND cells on the original complete assays and thirteen fUS sessions before admitting a candidate comparison.
Recover original folds, preprocessing, trial masks, class metrics and aggregation; changed whole-trial/held-session/held-animal splits are extensions.
Predeclare a joint behavioral/neural rule with task-specific meaningful changes and uncertainty across the full vector; improving WFCI1 MSE alone does not establish this registered full-scope win.
Preserve original neural-history input and fUS supervised-sample restrictions with matched comparator budgets.
Separate published table scores, fresh author reruns and any independently sourced later SOTA scores.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
participant_inputs: Full source-defined cropped128x128 widefield calcium fields with aligned behavior (248+412 trials) and all source-defined fUS sessions/conditions with2Hz Power Doppler fields; compressed factors only if exact input reconstruction is established.
